question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Compact
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Dense'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Compact" **is a word which means closely and neatly packed together; small and convenient (संक्षिप्त या संगठित)
 
• **"Dense" **(Option 1) meaning closely compacted in substance or packed, serves as the best synonym for "compact" (सघन)

Therefore, the** correct answer **is- **'Dense'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Expand" **(Option 2) meaning to become or make larger or more extensive (विस्तार) is not a suitable synonym for "Compact"
 
• **"Whole" **(Option 3) meaning all of; entire (संपूर्ण) is not a suitable synonym for "Compact"
 
• **"Holistic"** (Option 4) meaning dealing with or treating the whole of something or someone and not just a part (समग्र) is not a suitable synonym for "Compact"
